5d:T53d,The US Department of Defense published a notice on 2026-06-10 (91 FR 35189) designating Alibaba Group Holding Limited a Chinese military company under Section 1260H of the FY2021 National Defense Authorization Act; a removal notice published on 2026-11-10 concerned a different company. Alibaba's 20-F filed on 2026-05-20 disclosed an earlier listing in February 2026 that was withdrawn, and stated that the designation mainly prohibits the Department of Defense from business dealings with listed entities and does not trigger blocking sanctions. The South China Morning Post reported on 2026-10-29 that a US court granted Alibaba a preliminary injunction limited to a related lobbying restriction and that the designation remains in place while Alibaba's challenge continues. Alibaba Group and Alibaba Cloud entities were not found on the US Consolidated Screening List (which includes the Entity List, SDN List and the Chinese Military-Industrial Complex Companies list), the UK Sanctions List, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list or Canada's consolidated autonomous sanctions list in files downloaded on 2026-11-20. The 20-F also states that US export controls restrict the group's access to advanced AI chips.
